office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Corinna Harn is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge with more than 25 years of judicial experience who serves as the court's Assistant Presiding Judge, per her pamphlet statement.
highlights: Currently Assistant Presiding Judge and Executive Committee member [S1]
